quest.title: Glory's Wish
quest.description: Glory from Mondstadt needs three sets of Dandelion Seeds.

talks.objective: Give three sets of Dandelion Seeds to Glory

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, I hear you need dandelions...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Ah, did you come over to help after seeing my request? Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Have you brought the Dandelion Seeds?

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Please put them in my hand... Thank you.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: It's fine. Once you have them, please give them to me as soon as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Yes, these are Dandelion Seeds, indeed. Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I have a small gift for you. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: May my wishes travel well with the wind...
